title: BedCooldown
description: Adds a cooldown between bed uses.
body:
# BedCooldown

Adds a cooldown between bed uses.

## Features
- Cooldown on bed entries.
- Works with vanilla sleeping.
- Configurable duration.
- Simple and safe.

## Command
- `/bedcooldown status | /bedcooldown reload`

## Permissions
- `bedcooldown.use`
- `bedcooldown.admin`

## Config (snippet)
```yml
cooldown-seconds: 120
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4

## Install
1. Drop the jar into `plugins/`.
2. Restart the server.
3. Edit `config.yml` and run the reload command.
